description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically testing the PooledQueueCache and associated classes related to pooled buffers, cache data adapters, and message serialization/deserialization. It uses Xunit for testing and references multiple Orleans internal components.

classes.name: TestQueueMessage
classes.description: Represents a test message with stream ID, sequence number, payload data, and enqueue time.

classes.name: TestBatchContainer
classes.description: A test implementation of IBatchContainer, holding stream id, sequence token, and data, with unimplemented GetEvents and ImportRequestContext methods.

classes.name: TestCacheDataAdapter
classes.description: Implements ICacheDataAdapter for deserializing CachedMessages into IBatchContainer instances.

classes.name: CachedMessageConverter
classes.description: Converts TestQueueMessage instances into CachedMessage objects, handling serialization into pooled segments and managing buffer pools and eviction strategies.

methods.name: RunGoldenPath
methods.description: Populates the cache with messages, then retrieves and verifies messages for two streams via cursors, testing cache fill and iteration.

methods.name: AvoidCacheMiss
methods.description: Test helper to verify correct cache behavior when messages are added/removed around a cursor, both with empty and non-empty caches.
